notes.title: BAPBAP 1.0 Preview Patch!
notes.notes:
[p]Yoyo Bappers!
[/p][h3][b]THE 1.0 PREVIEW PATCH IS LIVE NOW![/b][/h3][p]The official launch is on [b]August 19th[/b], but we're pushing all the changes live a bit early for you guys to try and break stuff.[/p][h3]
Features:[/h3][p]- Kat, the Catmancer is now available
- 2 new maps, Temple and Tireclub
- New augments
- Background music added for every map
- New skins
- Some light balance changes (Kamikaze nerfed :eyes:)[/p][p] It's been a long ride and outside of bug fixes and stability patches, we're happy to call this the [b]definitive version of BAPBAP. [/b][/p][p]A genuine, chuck-sized thank you for all your support through the years. We couldn't have made BAPBAP without you.[b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b]Read the full blog here: [url="https://baphq.notion.site/015-1-0-Launch-24ed25b25d7980698fd2e9528d42f303"]https://baphq.notion.site/015-1-0-Launch-24ed25b25d7980698fd2e9528d42f303[/url][/p]

notes.title: Free Char Pack Deadline, Lobby v2, Balance, and Optimization Patch
notes.notes:
New patch: v0.1.2159.31677

We pushed the free character pack sign up deadline to the end of the Early Access period. All accounts made during Early Access will get the character pack permanently now - we'll let you know when official launch is coming up!

[b]Lobby v2[/b]
- Updated visuals on the lobby screen.
- All players can now see a preview of some high-level settings changed by the host.
- Moved the Settings Preset dropdown from inside of the Settings menu to the lobby screen.
- Added "Random Character" as a separate option in character select. This will show your character as "random" until the game starts.
- Host is now able to change other people's team.
- Host can now change the lobby's name. This will appear in the lobby list as well.
- Host can now Randomize Teams of specified sizes.
- Host can now disable the ability for players to change their own team.
- Lobby List has been visually updated.
- Lobby List can now be sorted (ascending or descending) by different categories.
- Added an in-game timer that shows in the lobby while a game is in progress. This will be visible to players that join a lobby that is in-game.
- Removed client-initiated chat messages
- Added lobby chat history
- Username bug fix on complete account

[b]Optimizations[/b]
- Graphics Optimizations (Memory Usage & Rendering Improvements)
- Add more Graphics Options
- Add Fallback Fog for when Volumetric Lighting Disabled
- Fix Rendering Issues on Mac
- Potential fix for Fullscreen crash

[b]Others[/b]
- Arena saved settings fixes
- Augment ui interact fixes
- Turret target detection hidden target fixes
- Small vfx/anim fixes (chains, spinpole)
- UI Interact window casting progress ui fix
- Jumppad no fow while in air
- FoW renderer resolution scale jitter fix
- Tentacle rig client jitter fix
- Airborne anim not playing on chuck jumps and others fix
- Controller UI navigation with D-Pad and other nav fixes
- Skull potato reset on round end
- Peak teleporters fix 
- Drone fix
- Lots of augment icons updated

[b]Balance[/b]
- Sofia
Base HP Increased
Damage scaling increased on all abilities
Base damage on Ultimate increased

- Skinny
Base HP Increased
Basic attack base damage increased
Basic attack scaling increased

- Jiro
Base Ultimate cooldown reduced

- Rocky
Big Rock radius reduced
More Rocks More Muscle Damage per HP reduced

- Froggy
Licky Wicky on hit CD reduced

- Chuck
Titan's tradeoff damage reduced

- Generic Augments:
Kamikazi CD stat reduced

notes.title: Alpha "Quick Join" feature and some bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks for all the feedback and love since we launched Early Access

This is a quick patch to address some of the most immediate feedback and bugs

Patch V0.1.2133-f46a5

[list]
[*] Added a Alpha version of "Quick Join" button to the main menu - This will join a lobby hosted in your region that has available space and isn't in-game
[*] Being AFK as a host will auto close your lobby in 5min
[*] Added up to 5 saved custom arena settings
[*] Right-Clicking a player in the lobby can now be done on the entire UI element
[*] Added "Copy Username" option to right-clicking a player in the lobby - This copies the full display name and discriminator
[*] Updated the UI of Sofia's Ult ability to better communicate when the ability can and cannot be used
[*] Fixed skins showing up multiple times in character select
[*] Fixed incorrect character names showing up on some mastery items
[*] Fixed your banner not updating in the lobby after changing it
[*] Fixed region bug in lobby list
[*] Added "Play with friends" modal for new players
[*] Clicking Join Button will immediately show the lobby list
[*] Teevee augment clone vfx dps is team colored
[*] Fixed placement being incorrect for winner team
[*] Guns now are dropped faster when fully used
[*] New sawed off shotgun model
[*] 🪨 Tactical ability vfx improvements
[*] Camera perma zoomed bug fixed
[*] Some general fixes and improvements
[*] New "Flashpoint" preset: tailored for super short matches 
[/list]



Thanks for joining us in BAPBAP! Feel free to drop by our Discord and have a chat - a bunch of the devs hang around and we're always down to chat

That's all for now,
Happy Bapping!

notes.title: #001 - THE BAPPENING, Spawn Picking and Map Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43864355/b83d4eb84948bd8e3ffd1f69f60a492fbac63c7f.png[/img]

Yoyo,

[h2]THE BAPPENING IS HAPPENING![/h2]

As mentioned last week, we're finally closing the queue while we go into our pre-launch phase. Thank you everyone for testing the Open Beta with us.

We'll be introducing new, frequent dev blogs to keep you guys in the loop - you can find a new post on MAP CHANGES AND SPAWNPICKING on the [url=https://baphq.notion.site/BAPBAP-Blog-2082532a3d924ef08b6abc4a95408b09]blog here[/url]

Common Q/A:
[b]Will Open Beta progression carry over to launch? 
[/b]Yep!

[b]How will I know if I get accepted to the playtest? 
[/b]Oh, you'll know. (Likely though discord or a steam email)

[b]How do I sign up?
[/b]Fill out this form: https://forms.gle/tURjwR2YgNynvecj7
and request access on steam (Wishlist us while you're there)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226280/BAPBAP/

[b]Will filling out the form AND wishlisting/signing up on Steam increase my chances of being picked?
[/b]Sure, why not.

[b]When will the game launch?
[/b]No confirmed date yet! 

That's all for now but you'll be hearing from us frequently!
